$Comment: A sample overlay for build_room.py: vanilla's Cursed Crypt hall with a brazier relay over it. Four braziers stand
on the hall's own floor (OnFloor finds it); lighting all four before the first burns out drops the bars the
overlay puts in the north doorway. The base room file lends the hall's doors, Box, tags and Fill.
Build it with --base-prefabs pointing at vanilla's Server/Prefabs folder.
Label: Sample brazier crypt
